head_commit.message:
Add PermissionRequest approval hooks

Add a PermissionRequest hook event across the hooks engine, approval flow, and UI surfaces so approval prompts can be intercepted before user or guardian review. This wires the new hook into command, edit, network, and exec approval entrypoints and adds integration coverage for the Bash and Edit matcher contracts.
